title: Ragtime and why his parents disapproved
summary: He explains that ragtime used four-four time unlike European waltzes and one-steps, and that his parents thought only bums played it.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: What the word "jazz" means: origins, Dixieland and labels

blocks.x: Is that what the music was when you heard Walker and Williams? That was ragtime music then?

Yes, there was only ragtime music and carnival music, that's all they used in those days. See, because we hadn't got up to the place, And, you see, the blacks were the first ones to use four-four. And have any ragtime at all.

The white Americans had come from Europe. They only knew of two types of time. And that was the waltz, like the Strauss waltzes, and the one-step. So, you see they didn't know anything about what we were doing. And that's why we called it 'ragtime', because, most of us -- it was such a thing that -- it wasn't thought much of. Because my parents, they certainly didn't want me to play a ragtime, because they said, "Only bums play ragtime." And I didn't know that I was going to be a bum later.

But they only said -- and there was only one thing that was going to happen to me for playing ragtime -- you'd end up with consumption, tuberculosis, or you'd end up in somebody's penitentiary.
